reasons.claim: The notification is a 9.6 ha regeneration felling in Lindesberg (polygon 10.71 ha). No completed felling overlaps the polygon.

One eligible site-bound VU species is recorded within 250 m: the lichen Alectoria sarmentosa, 164 m from the polygon edge. The record is from 2017 with 5 m uncertainty. Its listed threats include lack of continuity forest, lack of old/large trees and changed stand structure and tree-species composition.

The NT fungus Hydnellum ferrugineum is recorded at 170-223 m, with records from 2017 and 2025. Its listed threats include lack of continuity forest and forestry ground disturbance. It is supporting evidence only, as a single NT species.
Effort is adequate (210 records, 64th percentile). Near-site recording within 250 m is 32 records on 7 days.

uncertainties: The only eligible record is a single 2017 lichen record. Current occupancy is unknown.
The record lies outside the polygon. Whether the same habitat extends into the polygon is unknown.
Two records within 250 m were dropped for coordinate uncertainty.
not_established: That any red-listed species occupies the polygon today.
That the felling would affect these species. No cause is established.
next_action: Reviewer should check whether the habitat around the 2017 Alectoria sarmentosa record at 164 m extends into the polygon. They should consider a field survey before felling starts.
